name: Okavango Delta
about: Flood waters peak Jun–Aug and animals concentrate through Oct — the classic dry-season game-viewing window.
overview: A vast inland river delta reachable only by small plane or boat, among the most exclusive safari destinations on Earth.
costOverview: Virtually everything here is bundled into one all-inclusive nightly rate — flights, meals, drinks, and game drives — so there's no real budget or mid-tier version of this destination.

specialSeasons.text: Floodwaters arriving from Angola concentrate wildlife along the Delta's remaining channels.
